--- pipe_aggregate_group_and_order.sql
FROM Sales
|> AGGREGATE SUM(amount) AS total ASC
   GROUP AND ORDER BY category, region area DESC

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 10,
            Name:    "Sales",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeAggregate{
        Pipe:  11,
        Items: []*ast.PipeAggregateItem{
          &ast.PipeAggregateItem{
            DirPos: 45,
            Expr:   &ast.CallExpr{
              Rparen: 34,
              Func:   &ast.Path{
                Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                  &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 24,
                    NameEnd: 27,
                    Name:    "SUM",
                  },
                },
              },
              Args: []ast.Arg{
                &ast.ExprArg{
                  Expr: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 28,
                    NameEnd: 34,
                    Name:    "amount",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
            As: &ast.AsAlias{
              As:    36,
              Alias: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 39,
                NameEnd: 44,
                Name:    "total",
              },
            },
            Dir: "ASC",
          },
        },
        GroupBy: &ast.PipeAggregateGroupBy{
          Group:  52,
          And:    58,
          Order:  62,
          By:     68,
          Lparen: -1,
          Rparen: -1,
          Items:  []*ast.PipeAggregateGroupByItem{
            &ast.PipeAggregateGroupByItem{
              DirPos: -1,
              Expr:   &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 71,
                NameEnd: 79,
                Name:    "category",
              },
            },
            &ast.PipeAggregateGroupByItem{
              DirPos: 93,
              Expr:   &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 81,
                NameEnd: 87,
                Name:    "region",
              },
              As: &ast.AsAlias{
                As:    -1,
                Alias: &ast.Ident{
                  NamePos: 88,
                  NameEnd: 92,
                  Name:    "area",
                },
              },
              Dir: "DESC",
            },
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM Sales |> AGGREGATE SUM(amount) AS total ASC GROUP AND ORDER BY category, region area DESC
